description.narrative: Ukrainian women entrepreneurs face gender-based barriers and lack the necessary knowledge and practical skills in business planning in a modern business environment. On one hand, this is due to generally inadequate entrepreneurship/business education in Ukraine (theory-oriented instead of skills-oriented) and on the other hand due to gender-based barriers (like discrimination) in a business environment dominated by men. Moreover, during the war, the role of women has changed. Since many men are enlisted, women have become those who are now of the Ukrainian economy. At the same time, the number of obligations for women has clearly increased - to provide for the family, take care of children, and develop themselves to cope with all this.In addition, the war itself causes psychological stress (PTSS etc.). Ukrainian women are to develop themselves in business skills and in coping strategies for the war. The specific training needs and other support depend very much on the local situation. For this reason, three different locations were selected, including de-occupied regions - Irpin, Borodyanka (Kyiv region) and Poltava - a region where a lot of refugees settled down.The ambition of CSR Ukraine is to have eventually a network of service centres for female business owners and managers that are business-oriented (financing, consultation, etc.) as well as supportive (child care, psychological counselling, heating, etc.). Ukraine itself has little tradition in developing business Therefore CSR Ukraine needs a partner with the necessary skills for this.
